title: Rundeck: In Eclipse Jetty, HttpClient may receive a redirect of the form: ``` /secure/ (CVE-2026-76184)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-76184) affects Rundeck versions prior to 6.0.1-r11. The issue involves the Eclipse Jetty HttpClient component, which may improperly handle redirects of the form '/secure/'. This flaw has been assigned a CVSS 4.0 base score of 8.2, indicating a significant security risk. A fix is available in Rundeck version 6.0.1-r11.
